definitions.beyond_frontier: a window whose boundary comes after the prefix frontier; the population the prefix-only compiler cannot reach
definitions.families: canonical hashes of interior windows (one per episode and hash, the largest); support in distinct groups
definitions.h1: pass iff, under the primary catalog and the projected policy, beyond-frontier groundable share >= 0.20 and some beyond-frontier family has support >= 92
definitions.interior_boundary: a MODEL_REQ that is not the first boundary of the trajectory
definitions.interior_groundable_region: an Algorithm 2 window starting at an interior boundary with every slot LITERAL, NOT_GROUNDABLE or GROUNDED, under the strict (entry-schema) or projected (entry or prior-result) live-in policy
definitions.interior_read_only_run: consecutive compilable calls from an interior boundary to the next barrier
definitions.prefix_frontier: the first event that ends the read-only opening: a non-compilable call, a HANDOFF/APPROVAL/GUARDRAIL, or a failed tool result

evidence_class: provider-free trace analysis of released benchmark trajectories; descriptive, not admission
not_evidence_for: admission, calibration, or dispatch of any artifact
unchanged continuation after a compiled interior region
savings in cost (removed requests are counted, not priced)
